model_output.rationale: All 5 lines billed with KX only; no GP/GO/GN on any line. CO-4+N822 on therapy CPTs 97530/97140/97116 = unprocessable on Medicare Part B — not adjudicated, no appeal rights. Chart note confirms PT treatment; GP is the required discipline modifier. New original claim (CLM05-3=1) with GP appended to all lines is the remedy.

root_cause.explanation: 97530, 97140, 97116 billed KX-only; therapy discipline modifier GP absent from all 5 lines. Chart note reads 'PT treatment note' — GP (physical therapy plan of care) required on every line.

next_action.detail: Append GP to all 5 lines (97530×2, 97140×2, 97116×1). Submit as new original CLM05-3=1 — no REF*F8, no frequency 7 (not accepted Part B). Do not appeal; CO-4/N822 is unprocessable with no appeal rights.

evidence.fact: All 5 lines: CO-4 + remark N822; only KX present, GP/GO/GN absent on every line.
All 5 SV1 segments carry modifier KX only; no GP/GO/GN submitted.
'PT treatment note' — physical therapy plan of care confirmed; GP modifier required for all lines.
CO-4+N822 on therapy CPTs = returned unprocessable; correct_and_resubmit as CLM05-3=1 with discipline modifier; frequency 7 rejected on Part B.

citations.rule: CO-4+N822 = unprocessable; new original (CLM05-3=1) with GP/GO/GN appended; never appeal or use frequency 7.
Medicare Part B: frequency 7 not accepted; use CLM05-3=1 for unprocessable resubmission.
